extractor.prompt: Stage 1 extraction, theme fundierung, per docs/synthesis-operations.md P1.
extractor.note: Founding in Hua XLIII/2 is the layering of the Gemuet on the Verstand: value-acts founded in objectivating acts, will founded in wish, feeling-apprehension founded in theoretical apprehension, and function founded in affection.

coverage_note: Part I SS 1, 5, 7 and Appendix I, and Part III SS 1, 3, 4 - the sections where the commentary states a founding relation in so many words. Not covered: Part I SS 2-4 and 6, Appendices II-IV, the whole of Part II (the arousal of feelings, the Gefuehlston, the intensity analyses), and Part III S 2.

units.claim: Valuing presupposes the object it bears on and is founded in a presentation, in another, objectifying act.
units.quote: valuing presupposes the object on which it bears: it is *founded* in a presentation, in another, "objectifying" act

units.claim: Objects constitute themselves as what they are through the understanding, before all value-being, and constitute themselves in their value-determinations through feeling.
units.quote: objects constitute themselves as what they are, and "before" all value-being, *through the understanding* (*durch den Verstand*); they constitute themselves with respect to their value-determinations *through feeling*

units.claim: Valuing the cigar as perceived is a new act founded in perceiving, in which the cigar stands there as a value.
units.quote: This valuing is a *new act founded in perceiving* (an act-impression), in which this cigar "stands there" as a value

units.claim: Thing-perception with its levels is to be distinguished from the perception of the higher objectivity - thing-value, good, use-object.
units.quote: one must distinguish *thing-perception* (matter-perception) with its various levels and *the perception of the higher objectivity*: thing-value, good, use-object, etc.

units.claim: The value-grounding determinates of a thing lead back, where demonstrable, to immanent and unity-values, which are foundational for all mediacy in value-holding.
units.quote: These latter, in case of demonstrability, are again led back to immanent and unity-values, which are foundational for all *mediacy* in the value-holding.

units.claim: Two value-meanings found a preference, whose correlate is the relative priority of one valued object over the other.
units.quote: The two value-meanings *found* a preference, whose correlate is the relative priority of A over B.

units.claim: The will is founded in the wish and through this is directed at a held-for-good, in the manner of making.
units.quote: the will, then, is founded in the wish, and through this it is directed at a held-for-good

units.claim: The pure will-moment of the fiat is non-self-sufficient and founded in the wish-underlay described.
units.quote: namely insofar as it (the pure will-moment of the fiat) is *non-self-sufficient*, founded in the described underlay

units.primary_locator: Hua XLIII/2, Part I, Beilage I
units.claim: Given that every Gemuetsakt is founded, it is asked whether the foundation is of apperception by apperception or also of act by act with respect to meaning.
units.quote: the question is whether the foundation takes place as foundation of *apperception* by apperception, or also (since the first foundation is unavoidable) of *act* by act *with respect to meaning*

units.claim: Through the feelings interwoven with and founded in the sensations, something constitutes itself, namely values.
units.quote: through the feelings *interwoven with*, *founded in* the sensations, *something* constitutes itself, *namely values*

units.claim: The blind motivations of the original feeling- and drive-passivities are constitutive for objectivities of higher level, for which the text has no comprehensive name.
units.quote: which are constitutive for *objectivities of higher level* — for which we have no comprehensive names: *objects of love*, *value-objects*, *deeds*, *creations*

units.claim: Every function is essentially founded in affection and forms with it the unity of a functional concrete whole of the experience.
units.quote: every function is *essentially founded in affection* and forms with it the *unity of a functional concrete whole of the experience*

units.claim: We are receptive with respect to the foundations of the acts of understanding and active with respect to the constitution of the understanding-objects.
units.quote: We are receptive with respect to the foundations of these acts*, but *active with respect to the constitution of the understanding-objects*

units.claim: Simple axiological apprehensions and their unities stand in connection with, and founded in, simple sensible thingly apprehensions.
units.quote: Here too we find relatively "simple" axiological apprehensions and unities of such apprehensions in connection with, and founded in, simple sensible (thingly) apprehensions.

units.claim: The primary feeling undergoes a feeling-apprehension and becomes an intentional feeling founded in the sensible-theoretical appearance, making a higher-stage appearance possible.
units.quote: it becomes intentional feeling, which is founded in the sensible-theoretical appearance and makes possible a higher-stage appearance
